activities.subject: Looking for competitive intel support for upcoming oat launch
activities.body:
Hi Alex — We're preparing for a new oat milk launch in mid-May and want a fast, leadership-ready view of what Oatly + Califia are doing in Canada. We've used similar reports before and want something that blends data with clear takeaways.

We care most about:
1) Paid Search: brand vs generic keywords, messaging themes, landing pages.
2) Social / Video: what's working on YouTube/IG/TikTok, creative patterns, creators.
3) Paid Media: where they're investing (channels + spend directionally), and any recent spikes.

We'd love a concise brief and a deck we can share internally. Timing is tight — ideally we start in March and have outputs by mid-April.

Budget is likely in the 40–60K CAD range but we can confirm after a quick scoping call.

Thanks!
Sarah

activities.subject: Re: competitive intel support for upcoming oat launch
activities.body:
Thanks Sarah — makes sense. A couple quick questions so we scope this right:

1) Which competitors are must-have vs nice-to-have? (You mentioned Oatly + Califia)
2) Do you want a one-time snapshot, or a short trend view (last 6–12 months)?
3) Any specific channels you *don't* care about?

If you're free Thursday, we can do 25 minutes to lock scope + timeline.

Alex

activities.subject: Re: competitive intel support for upcoming oat launch
activities.body:
Hi Alex — must-have competitors: Oatly + Califia. Nice-to-have: Silk (mostly for paid search comparisons).

Trend window: last 12 months is ideal, but if that's heavy, last 6 months is fine.

Channels we care about most: Paid Search + YouTube. Secondary: Instagram/TikTok. We're less focused on display unless you see a meaningful spike.

Also, leadership wants 3–5 clear 'so what' strategic implications, not just charts.

Thursday works — anytime between 11am–2pm PT.

Sarah

meeting.title: Scoping call — Earth's Own competitive intel

activities.notes:
Goals: leadership-ready view of Oatly + Califia activity in Canada to inform Earth's Own oat launch (target May 15).

Key questions they want answered:
- Are competitors increasing paid search and what messaging angles are emerging?
- What creative patterns are working on YouTube and what topics/creators are they leaning into?
- Any recent spikes in spend, traffic, or video views that suggest a campaign push?

Deliverables discussed:
- 10–12 slide deck (executive summary + key findings)
- 1-page client brief / strategic implications section

Constraints:
- Tight timeline; want kickoff March 10 and delivery by April 15.
- They prefer directional spend ranges rather than exact figures (as long as trends are credible).

Success criteria:
- 3–5 actionable implications for Earth's Own launch strategy (channel focus, messaging themes, creative do's/don'ts).

Budget:
- Confirmed comfortable range CAD 40–60K.

activities.subject: Extra context + what leadership cares about
activities.body:
Hey Alex — adding a bit more color:

Leadership is very focused on:
- 'Where should we place our bets?' (Search vs Video vs Social)
- 'What messages are landing?' (taste, health, sustainability, price/value)
- 'What should we avoid copying?' (tired creative tropes)

If possible, include a short section called "Recommended Moves for Earth's Own" with 5 bullets.

Thanks,
Daniel
